text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86167, Back-to-Back 8 Inch Palermo Door Pull Set

The Tuscany Palermo Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair features the ever popular barrel middle design. It is this design that has become a classic amongst traditional hardware because it is chic but still has an air of the old world. The Back-to-Back 8 Inch Palermo Door Pull Set comes packaged as a set of 2 handles and the necessary mounting hardware. It will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick. Choose from either flat black or medium bronze finishes.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Palermo Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Tuscany Palermo Lost Wax Cast Bronze Pull Set:

  • Material: Lost Wax Cast Bronze
  • Total Length: 9-1/4"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1-1/16"
  • Total Projection: 2-13/16"
  • Base: 1-1/4"
  • Clearance: 1-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
